question: Where’s the closest hotel positioned on the way to Thunder Road Museum, Mt Airy, NC from Basin Cove Overlook, Laurel Springs, NC?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.20012 36.39093)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.708507 36.502824)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'hotel'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.20012 36.39093)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.20012 36.39093)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Basin Cove Overlook, Laurel Springs, NC

[3].display_name: Thunder Road Museum, Mt Airy, NC
